item.title: Stoned To Death: Creativity, Collaborations and Pint Claddaghs
item.description: Bevin (Bev) Armstrong’s journey as a jeweller and creative started just over two years ago, as a form of art therapy. Since then, Armstrong has moved to London and Stoned To Death has evolved into a brand focused on creating gender-affirming jewellery with an Irish flair. In their studio, Bev does it all, from jewellery making to tattooing to print design. item.description: Horror has been attached to womanhood for as long as the arts have existed, as a phenomenon, a metaphor and even a by-product; whether it be the legendary Colchian sorcerer princess Medea, the young wife in the attic in Charlotte Perkins Gilman’s short story or the child-bride turned “chudail” in the 2020 Hindi film Bulbbul. item.title: Erika Kirk to Recruit Students for New TPUSA Brand in Northern Ireland
item.description: Erika Kirk, CEO of right-wing think tank Turning Point USA (TPUSA) and the widow of American political commentator Charlie Kirk, is expected to visit Northern Ireland on a tour to recruit young people to the organisation. According to the Belfast Telegraph, ex-DUP MP Ian Paisley Jr is backing a plan to launch a branch of TPUSA in Northern Ireland. item.title: Trinity Basketball Launches New Movember Kit Alongside Longstanding Breast Cancer Awareness Jerseys
item.description: Trinity Basketball has launched a new black Movember kit, produced in partnership with kit sponsor Isobasketball, to accompany the club’s long-established pink Breast Cancer Awareness jerseys. The two kits together form part of the club’s approach to raise awareness for both men’s and women’s health. item.title: Plant-Based Trinity: A Real Commitment to Sustainability
item.description: Currently, there are 23 Plant-Based Universities (PBUs), including the University of Bristol, the University of Birmingham, and University College London. PBUs are universities that either exclusively serve (or are transitioning to exclusively serve) food that is not derived from animals. PBUs aim to “tackle the climate and nature crisis” by having universities transition to plant-based catering.
